purpose: Validate the unchanged P5C OPEN semantic-first runtime using an already-supported Computer Control application Provider for the semantic branch and the already-physically-validated P4/P5A visual-only fixture for the visual branch. This removes the irrelevant requirement that a custom Swift fixture also behave as a complete semantic AX application Provider.
requiredClaims: The semantic branch uses the registered local System Settings Computer Control application Provider and performs only safe navigation to the deterministic Wi-Fi target; it does not mutate a system setting.
OPEN attempts the existing semantic operation before any visual perception.
The semantic OPEN path is physically delivered and independently re-observed through semantic evidence without invoking P5A, the visual provider, or the post-action visual observer.
The visual target RUMIAI CLICK 517 is absent from the System Settings semantic representation and therefore produces structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
The visual-only target belongs to a separate test-owned fixture; P5C does not require semantic and visual evidence to originate from the same application process.
Only the P5B-eligible structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET result reaches the P5C visual handoff.

Visual fallback requires an execution-context object separate from planner intent with explicit allowVisualFallback=true, an injected provider, an exact visual target matching the OPEN target, a primary-display left-click request, an exact deterministic postcondition and a post-action observer.
The planner/LLM schema remains semantic and contains no visualFallback, targetQuery, provider selection or screen-coordinate fields.
The visual branch reuses the P4/P5A fixture that was already physically validated; no P1-P4 physical session is rerun.
A real P5A-coordinated Computer Control click returns CLICK_POSTED with semanticConsequenceVerified=false.

OPEN returns task success on the visual path only when a fresh independent post-action visual observation satisfies the exact deterministic RUMIAI DONE 864 postcondition and P4 returns VERIFIED_SUCCESS.
Posted delivery without verified postcondition remains NOT_VERIFIED_SUCCESS in contract coverage.
Semantic delivery failure, semantic verification failure, readiness/backend/internal/invalid failures do not become visual retries.
The physical visual branch uses the local macOS Vision PoC only as an injected provider; P5C does not select or package a perception provider for product runtime.
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean and no screenshot bytes, OCR payload text or action coordinates are persisted in immutable evidence.
nonClaims: P5C does not wire visual configuration or provider selection into the normal agent loop; that remains P5E after P5D.
P5C does not define concrete perception-provider discovery or selection; that is P5D.
System Settings is used only as a stable supported semantic surface for physical validation and is not a required product-specific OPEN implementation.
P5C does not require a visual fallback target to belong to the same application process as the semantic observability gap; policy and deterministic caller context remain authoritative.
P5C does not add coordinates, native identifiers, visual queries or postconditions to planner output.
P5C does not make arbitrary OPEN failures visually eligible.
P5C does not claim general OCR accuracy, fuzzy target matching, VLM/object/icon targeting, secondary/rotated display support or richer pointer actions.
The P1-P4 physical sessions are not rerun or rewritten; their immutable physical evidence remains authoritative.
P5A and P5B evidence is not rewritten by this session.
P5C s01 evidence commit 15976727c6b6a09b09b428c415c5daf74e6c0258 remains immutable as the historical unregistered custom-fixture failure.
P5C s02 evidence commit 86793f0077d0926554c71422e4394b3bf3c62b9a remains immutable as the historical registered-but-unsnapshotable custom-fixture failure.
P5C s03 evidence commit 26be209cfcdb9fa5ab81a2a23d823344c598a6d8 remains immutable as the historical LaunchServices custom-fixture snapshot failure.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s04 unchanged, diagnose the exact new failure, fix forward, and create s05.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: Only test-owned visual fixture text is used for visual targeting. Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain ephemeral and are not persisted or logged by the session evidence.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P5D concrete perception-provider delivery and selection boundary
